intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文寻宝反讽线记忆：宝藏梦差点成真、新机器 The Revealer 被发明并用来探测地下黄金、海边洞穴据说有海盗藏宝、探宝队进洞、机器显示地下有金子、大家兴奋开挖、最后只找到几乎不值钱的小金币和空铁皮箱，但人们仍然有希望。读的时候注意被动语态长句分组、it is said 的插入感，以及 In spite of this 的转折。

sentences.text: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：寻找失踪宝藏的梦想最近差点成真。Dreams of finding lost treasure 连成一个大期待，almost came true 读出“差一点”的感觉。

sentences.text: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一台叫 The Revealer 的新机器已经被发明，并被用来探测地下埋藏的黄金。长句按 called The Revealer / has been invented / has been used to detect / has been buried 分组。

sentences.text: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where -- it is said -- pirates used to hide gold.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：这台机器被用在海边附近的洞穴里，据说海盗过去常在那里藏金子。where 后稍停，it is said 像插入说明，pirates used to hide gold 收住背景传说。

sentences.text: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：海盗过去常把金子埋在洞里，后来却没能取走。would often 读出过去反复动作，fail to collect it 读出“没能取回”的遗憾。

sentences.text: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：探宝队带着新机器进洞，希望找到埋藏的宝藏。Armed with 在这里是 equipped with，不是武器；search party 是搜索队，不是派对。

sentences.text: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：队长正在检查洞口附近的土壤时，机器显示地下有金子。was examining 是正在进行，when the machine showed 是关键事件突然出现。

sentences.text: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他们最后找到一枚小金币，但它几乎不值钱。finally found 先给期待，almost worthless 再落下反讽。

sentences.text: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：尽管如此，很多人仍相信 The Revealer 很快可能发现有价值的东西。In spite of this 读出转折，confident 和 reveal something of value 读出希望还在。
